scientific_integrity: Universal bound and finite sharpness are proved analytically; finite rational checks supplement but do not certify the infinite-dimensional statement. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted open paths and full, consecutive windows only.
Exact optimal coefficient for shorter input paths with m<=n<2m is not determined.
Universal bound for even one-Lipschitz pair contrasts need not be individually sharp for every contrast.
Historical equivalences in unindexed literature are not excluded.
title: Sharp complete-graph cut law for sliding Gini dispersion in path variation
